success.title: Quote Request Received!
success.message: We'll send your quote within 1 hour via email.

banner.title: Check your inbox
banner.body: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Click it to confirm your email and help us prioritize your quote response.

verified.heading: Email verified
verified.body: Thanks for confirming your email. Our dispatcher will respond to your quote request within 1 business hour.

invalid_token.title: Verification link invalid
invalid_token.body: This verification link is not recognized. It may have been mistyped or already used. If you submitted a quote recently, please check for a fresh email or contact us.

expired_token.title: Verification link expired
expired_token.body: Verification links are valid for 7 days. Please submit a new quote request and we will send a fresh verification link.

already_verified.title: Already verified
already_verified.body: This email has already been verified. You can sign in to track your quote.

order_not_found.title: Quote not found
order_not_found.body: We could not find a quote associated with this verification link. If you submitted a quote recently, please contact us.

default.title: Verification failed
default.body: We could not verify your email at this time. Please try again or contact support.
